summary: Pull A day. Lunch pairs beer-battered cod with chicken breast and whole grain pasta, a fish/chicken mix after three straight chicken-only lunches; dinner stays chicken-forward with smoked chicken pasta alfredo plus extra chicken breast. Added chia seed at breakfast to help close the fiber gap.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Eggs, turkey, oats, bread and banana for a balanced protein/carb start; chia seed boosts fiber.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: Beer-battered cod as the main for fish variety, chicken breast and extra pasta round out protein and carbs.

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: wellness protein smoothie, half bagel, turkey.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Smoked chicken pasta alfredo as the protein-forward main, extra chicken breast closes out post-workout protein.

items.name: Smoked Chicken Pasta Alla Fredo, Watercress
